reviews.t: I didn't expect to like these
reviews.x: Let's start out by explaining that I have longer (waist length), fine hair, but a lot of it.  Nothing stays in my hair.  It tangles like a beast.  I've pretty much been living with my hair in a braid for the last year because it is the only thing I can do that doesn't end up in a huge mess but also mostly stays-well, except for all the frizzies and flyaways that sneak out.  So I was looking for another fast alternative to get my hair back and out of my face that also wouldn't require an hour of

reviews.t: A great product for extra long hair.
reviews.x: If you have extra long hair, these are a must to get it up and in a fast, easy bun that lasts.  No falling out and doesn't feel tight and uncomfortable.  I wish I tried these sooner.  Once you roll on the correct side of the bars, it's very easy.  I do have to double my hair back because it's so long but it works great.  My hair is down to my hips but I think it would work with below should length hair too. I hope this helps.

Previous to seeing (and ultimately purchasing) this product, I bought a pony-o brand bun bar that is supposed to do the same thing pretty much but you bend it yourself rather than it snapping into place. I find these easier to use and continue to get better at it the more I use it. I would say there is a bit of a learning curve to it, so the first time might not be perfect, just keep trying. I think once my hair gets a little longer it will be a bit easier to use with my hair... Worked great in
Do you remember slap bracelets? This is essentially 2 slap bracelets connected together and covered in fake hair... and I'm amazed by how easy it is to use, and how well it works!
Do you remember slap bracelets? This is essentially 2 slap bracelets connected together and covered in fake hair... and I'm amazed by how easy it is to use, and how well it works!
My hair is to my mid back and is too long for this to be secure

reviews.t: Fun to use as works well.
reviews.x: I have long straight hair. I was hoping this would keep it out of the way and stay neat. It is very easy to use and it works but my hair still slides out if worn for the day. You will need to use a ponytail holder then apply this to the hair. Maybe if I use it more, I will be able to do it better. One fun thing that happens after wearing it for an extended period of time is that it made my straight hair wavy when I took it down.

These bun makers are way less expensive than others on the market. They work kind of like the old snap bracelets, only for your hair. The only problem I had is that the first time I used one of them, one side would not stay straightened back out, making it difficult to use.  There is a bit of a learning curve, but they are easy once you figure them out. And there are four in a package, which is really nice if you tend to lose things like I do, LOL.

Once you get the hang of it, it's so convenient for my quick(ish) messy buns before work. I have thick hair with zero texture & these hold perfectly into place. The thick bobby pins that are included are perfect for helping secure your bun.

I returned these. For me they were disastrous. They have a very fast and hard snap into a curled position when you begin to bend them and then it’s really a pain to straighten them out to try again. Horrible!! They went back the next day!!

I am obsessed with these!! Basically a double layered slap bracelet—works perfectly on my adult hair and all of my children from toddler to preteen! Honestly one of the best purchases I’ve made for under $6. Not gimmicky, totally works!...and I can do it by myself and I’m not good with hair at all!!

These are the best for long hair!! I can whip my hair up abs it looks precessional in less than 5 minutes. I keep losing them around the house so I keep buying more! Love these! Highly recommend for long hair (mine is to my waist line.)

reviews.t: Too slippery to hold hair/ poor quality.
reviews.x: The wrapping around the sticks doesn't hold my hair well and my hair kept slipping out. These are cheaply made and not easy to use!!!
I love this! My hair is thin so it works well for me. I'm not sure anyone with longer, thicker hair would have the same results.
I have these and I have a Pony-O bun bar. These hold a bun in much better for me than my Pony-O one, and I have curly hair.
Not easy to work with. I tried so many different ways and they do not work well.
Used these years ago and love them. They help make a perfect bun every time!

It does take some practice to figure it out, but works great once you do. I just wouldn't recommend it for everyone. I have thick hair that goes a couple inches below my shoulders, and I don't think they'd work for anyone with thin or shoulder-length hair. You can also only roll it in an upward direction. If you try rolling it downwards, it won't catch the whole length of your hair and will roll out. It also helps to leave a tail and tuck it up under the bun maker after you've got it in. With th

reviews.t: Worked for my long thick hair!
reviews.x: This is way better than the one I bought at the grocery store. My hair goes past my hips and it’s fairly thick, so I’ve had a hard time figuring out how to keep it out of the way comfortably. It took my a few tries at first to get a good bun. I ended up having to put it in a high ponytail first, and I found it much easier to do the bun with my hair upside down (but that is how I’ve always put my hair up).

I dont think its the product itself, its the process thats tricky. Not easy to use at all. The product was what it said, not damaged, colors are great and when I could figure out how to use it, it stayed in place. The adverisements make it look simple and it is not. If you know how to use them, these are great and half the price of the others and I wouldnt say theres a difference.

reviews.t: Worked for my long, thick hair
reviews.x: Was looking for a bun maker strong enough to hold my hair. My hair length is to my low back and fairly thick. One tip I suggest is to put your hair in a ponytail first, then do the bun maker at the bottom of the hair. I had to play around with how to bend it. I bent it circular rather than the way the pic shows… but voilà! I have an easy neat bun!!!

Hair is about down to my armpits. I put it in a ponytail first. I imagine it would be incredibly difficult to make a good bun without the ponytail, but if you had patience (I do not), I'm sure it is possible! These little guys are awesome though. Great way to keep my hair up and out of my way for sure! Glad I bought these!

This product was garbage! Deserves 0 stars.  These things didn't stay bent like they were supposed to. I tried each one and they all just bent and went back straight. Waste of time and money. I requested a refund and Amazon didn't require me to send the item back which was great. These things ended up in the trash 🙄

This product is different but I think that you will like it once you figure out how to work it. I have other items similar to this but this product I like better because it is easier to use in the long run it is easy and convenient to store and I don't think you can go wrong with purchasing it

reviews.t: Wish I’d known about these sooner!
reviews.x: These are fairly easy to use although the directions included aren’t that helpful. If you aren’t sure I’d check to see if there’s a video on YouTube. These are way easier to use on my daughter’s hair than a donut bc she has thick hair and it goes past her shoulders.

claims.text: Many reviewers find these easy and quick to use for making buns, especially once they get the hang of it.
Several reviewers say they work well for long hair, holding buns securely in place.
Some reviewers report their hair slips out or the product doesn't stay secure, especially for longer or thicker hair.
A few reviewers mention a learning curve or difficulty with the snap mechanism and straightening it back out.
Some reviewers note the product is inexpensive and good value compared to alternatives.
